quote: Sometimes you carry sorrow nobody else can see. You wear a quiet mask through every crowded room. The heavy thoughts linger long after midnight fades away. You wish someone would notice your silent suffering. Yet you keep walking forward without a single complaint. Healing requires patience when your spirit feels entirely exhausted. One day your heart will find its genuine peace.
